purpose: Re-certify the reduced-state closure only on a prospectively defined persistent live-insurgency support after the fielded-force semantic correction.

support_selection.selection_rule: Among eligible rates, choose the rate whose median runway_ratio is closest to 0.50; ties choose the lower recruitment multiplier. If no rate qualifies, closure recertification is blocked and support architecture must be revisited without running closure.
support_selection.rationale: Targets a nontrivial but non-exhausted resource regime without using any closure or policy-strategy outcomes.

closure_design.activity_strata: recomputed terciles using only eligible live-anchor states
closure_design.fielded_force_definition: active-owner effective force: zero whenever canonical insurgent organization is inactive
closure_design.common_random_numbers: candidate-independent branch streams as in gt-closure-v3

primary_gates: All selected pair anchors satisfy every live-anchor filter.
At least 24 matched pairs are available with approximately 8 per live-support activity stratum.
Overall significant-and-practically-large pair rate <= 0.10 under corrected outcomes.
Each activity stratum significant-and-practically-large pair rate <= 0.20.
Report owner-inactivation frequency during the 30-day continuation separately; collapse itself is a valid future event, not a reason to censor branches.
interpretation: PASS: restore strategic closure certification only for the prospectively selected live-insurgency support and corrected F semantics.
FAIL: retain direct mechanism findings but keep reduced-state decision-support certification suspended; characterize the residual before considering any new state coordinate.
guard: No historical outcomes and no government strategy outcomes may be used to choose the challenge regime, matching variables, or gates.
